media.alt_text: Text card describing Red Onion restaurant in Glasgow's dedicated gluten-free menu and 5 out of 5 GF score

caption.body:
Red Onion in Glasgow has a full dedicated GF menu — starters, mains, desserts — plus a dedicated fryer and a chef/owner who comes to the table to talk through allergies himself.

They also do GF-vegan and dairy-free-GF menus, and on Sundays there's a GF roast. Contemporary Scottish cooking and one of the best GF experiences I've had in Scotland.

5/5 on my GF safety scale. Full review on the site.
